## PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Chemical professional with more than 10 years of experience in chemical manufacturing, agrochemical production, and pharmaceutical intermediates. Experienced in handling batch processes, plant operations, shift management, equipment operation, safety compliance, and production monitoring. Skilled in operating reactors, centrifuges, ANFD, vacuum systems, and process equipment while ensuring product quality, safety, and productivity. Proven ability to manage plant operations independently and coordinate with production, maintenance, and quality teams for smooth plant functioning.

## PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Shiva Pharmachem Limited, Dahej

## Executive

December 2023 - Present

## Key Responsibilities:

- Managing day-to-day plant operations and batch manufacturing activities.
- Monitoring reaction parameters and ensuring compliance with process requirements.
- Coordinating with production, QA, QC, maintenance, and EHS departments.
- Maintaining production records, batch documents, and shift reports.
- Ensuring adherence to safety procedures, permit systems, and SOPs.
- Supervising manpower and maintaining smooth shift operations.
- Monitoring utility consumption and equipment performance.
- Troubleshooting process-related issues to improve productivity and yield.
- Maintaining housekeeping and ensuring compliance with GMP and safety standards.

## Tagros Chemicals India Pvt. Ltd., Panoli

## Plant Officer

October 2018 - December 2023

## Key Responsibilities:

- Independently handling production activities during shifts.
- Monitoring batch reactions and process parameters.
- Ensuring target production volumes and quality standards are achieved.
- Handling process equipment such as reactors, centrifuges, ANFD, and vacuum systems.
- Coordinating maintenance activities and minimizing downtime.
- Training operators on SOPs and safety practices.
- Preparing shift reports and production documentation.
- Ensuring safe handling of chemicals and hazardous materials.
- Implementing continuous improvement initiatives for process optimization.

## Bajaj Healthcare Limited, Panoli

## Plant Chemist

September 2015 - October 2018

## Key Responsibilities:

- Monitoring manufacturing operations and process activities.
- Conducting process checks and maintaining batch records.
- Assisting in process optimization and troubleshooting.
- Ensuring compliance with production schedules and quality requirements.
- Supporting scale-up and technology transfer activities.
- Coordinating with quality control for sampling and analysis.
- Maintaining safety and housekeeping standards in production areas.

## TECHNICAL EXPERTISE

## Process Equipment Handling

- Glass Lined Reactors (GLR)
- Stainless Steel Reactors (SSR)
- ANFD (Agitated Nutsche Filter Dryer)
- Centrifuges
- Vacuum Pumps
- Shifters
- Distillation Systems
- Drying Equipment

## Process Operations

- Batch Manufacturing
- Chemical Reactions Monitoring
- Filtration & Drying Operations
- Distillation Operations
- Solvent Recovery
- Utility Management
- Process Troubleshooting
- Yield Improvement

## Safety & Compliance

- Permit-to-Work System
- SOP Compliance
- Process Safety
- Housekeeping Management
- Shift Documentation
- Production Reporting

## PRODUCTS HANDLED

- Cypermethrin
- Hexanone
- 5CI
- Agrochemical Intermediates
- Pharmaceutical Intermediates
- Specialty Chemical Products

- Understanding of chemical plant operations.
